model: One nonpreemptive link; finite waiting queue; tail drop; no expiry drops.
deadline_note: All deadlines and traffic parameters are synthetic, not clinical targets.
dataset_note: Synthetic experiment data, not calibrated to real hospital measurements. Class priorities apply in both modes; class size/rate/deadline settings are generator defaults only. Replay uses CSV arrival times, sizes and absolute deadlines.
observation: 0 to max(arrival horizon, final completion), separately for each policy.
metric_notes: Delay statistics cover delivered packets; on-time success divides by all generated packets. Every class has a deadline, so deadline_buffer_drops equals buffer_dropped. Link time percent is class transmission time / observation; ALL is link utilization. Throughput includes all delivered bytes over the same observation interval.
